raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 re-delivered 338 transactions that already exist in batch 13 or earlier, one copy with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (e.g. 1768716261000, which equals 2026-01-18 06:04:21 UTC, matching the other copy) and a later ingest_ts. The cast fails on the epoch value, and without deduplication the duplicates would double-count gold totals. Normalizing epoch-millis timestamps and keeping one row per txn_id (earliest ingest_ts) fixes both problems in silver, and gold reads from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) = 1;"}}
